title: Sums of the first odd numbers
caption: 1, 1 + 3, 1 + 3 + 5, … give 1, 4, 9, 16, 25. The differences are the odd numbers being added, and the dot squares show each total is a square: the conjecture is that the sum of the first n odd numbers is n².
alt: The terms 1, 4, 9, 16, 25 drawn as square arrays of dots, with the differences 3, 5, 7, 9 between them.
description: Add the first n odd numbers for n = 1 to 5: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25.
Each total is a perfect square, drawn here as an n by n array of dots.
The differences 3, 5, 7, 9 are the next odd number added each time.
Conjecture: the sum is n². It still needs proving.
